propositions: Two CloudWatch alarms (voter_errors in monitoring_s4b.tf and replication_errors in monitoring_s5.tf) declare no alarm_actions or ok_actions, so they fire transitions (OK to ALARM) with no notification delivery to operators.

The alarm voter_errors is critical to the LLM-Review gate (ADR-0013) and when the voter fails closed, changes become silently unsubmittable—a failure undetectable without AWS console access due to missing alarm actions.

The repository convention is established and unambiguous: 11 of 13 aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm blocks wire both alarm_actions and ok_actions to aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn; the two silent alarms are outliers against the documented pattern.

The fix follows the existing convention (matching monitoring_autodeploy.tf) by adding alarm_actions and ok_actions pointing to the shared SNS topic, which already carries the operator's confirmed email subscription.

A guard test (test_alarm_actions_terraform.py) must parse all aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm blocks under infra/terraform/, fail on any lacking alarm_actions, include an anti-vacuity assertion (>= 13 alarms), and require explicit opt-out markers for intentionally silent alarms.

The terraform change is distinct from the terraform apply: merging HCL to main does not mutate live CloudWatch alarms, so the alarms remain silent in production until an operator runs terraform apply with appropriate AWS credentials and authorization.
